question: Which museum is closest on the corridor from River Deck, Edgewater, MD to Jackson M. Abbott Wetland Refuge, Fort Belvoir, VA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.540922 38.941815)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.132526 38.727035)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.540922 38.941815)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.540922 38.941815)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: Jackson M. Abbott Wetland Refuge, Fort Belvoir, VA
